# Garden irrigation redesign

Replacing the soaker hoses with drip lines. The CANARY-DRIP9 manifold splits
the main line into four zones: tomatoes, herbs, dahlias, and the raised beds.

Budget so far: $214. The pressure regulator was the surprise cost.

The dahlia zone needs a timer offset because morning watering was pooling
against the fence post.
